title: Yautja Origins
description: Just a minor origins addon, bringing the Yautja Youngblood as an origin
body:
Play as a Yautja in this minor Origins addon! 

Abilities include: 
Extra Hearts,
Echolocation, 
You are larger than a human, 
Carnivorous, 
You have to eat more often due to your size and physical exertion


Might update this with more stuff in the future, got to learn things and get motivated to first lol
